failure_modes.name: Reverse Polarity Destruction
failure_modes.symptom: Immediate short circuit across power rails; exploded capacitor; burnt IC package
failure_modes.preventive_circuit: Series Schottky diode or reverse-P-channel MOSFET ideal diode circuit at power input jack

failure_modes.name: Inductive Kickback Voltage Spike
failure_modes.symptom: Switching element fails short after driving relay or DC motor
failure_modes.preventive_circuit: Flyback freewheeling diode (e.g. 1N4007 or 1N5819) reverse-biased across inductive coil

failure_modes.name: Floating CMOS Input Oscillation
affected_components: Microcontroller GPIOs in high-Z input mode
failure_modes.symptom: Erratic behavior, high quiescent current, random logic toggling
failure_modes.preventive_circuit: 10k ohm pull-up or pull-down resistor to define known logic state
